reasoning_content:

The OTP row with 22:35:44 was created during the first attempt — this was before I fixed the DNS alias. Wait: at 22:35:44, init-email-login created the OTP (the row shows _created_at 22:35:44.372087). After that, it tried to send the email and got ENOTFOUND mailcatcher at 22:35:47 → 500. But the OTP row was still left in the DB (the error occurred after the OTP was saved).

On the second attempt (22:36:01), the cooldown kicked in: "Email login OTP re-requested within the cooldown window" → 201, no new email was sent, and the OTP is not resent. In other words, the email was not delivered at all.

Let's look at the rest of the controller, check the email sending mechanism, and confirm how the email is actually being dispatched.
